steps: Obtain a bankHometown Refer-A-Friend slip from a branch or download it.
Give the slip to friends or family (write your name on it).
Your friend brings the slip to a bankHometown office and opens a new checking account, naming you as referrer.
Your friend enrolls in eStatements and within 90 days posts $1,000 in direct deposits or 25 debit transactions of $10+.
The $50 bonus is credited to your account by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day.
timing: Bonus credited to the Customer's account by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day the friend's account was opened.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus credited to the Customer's account by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day the friend's account was opened. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
